name: 52hzagents-desktop
description: 52hzAgent Studio Local-First Multi-Agent Orchestration Desktop Client

scripts.sync-public: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src='../frontend/out',dest='resources/public';if(!fs.existsSync(src)){console.error('frontend/out missing - run build-frontend first');process.exit(1);}if(fs.existsSync(dest))fs.rmSync(dest,{recursive:true,force:true,maxRetries:3});fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true});console.log('Frontend export cleanly synced to resources/public');"
scripts.sync-all: npm run build-icons && npm run build-frontend && npm run sync-public
